$comment: The model providers the Python CLI can run on. Every fact here is a TRANSPORT fact:
endpoint, credential environment variables, default model, identity system text, and
for Anthropic the Claude Code OAuth login this tool was born on. Behaviour that is
policy rather than fact - retries, sentinel recovery, schema shaping, the 429 backoff
curve - stays in engine.agent() behind this seam, per ADR-0001 and ADR-0004.
A provider is ADDABLE HERE without engine changes only while it speaks the Anthropic
Messages wire format (tools + tool_choice). A different wire needs a real adapter and
an ADR of its own; none exists yet, and none is pretended to.
The glm baseUrl is the vendor's documented Anthropic-compatible endpoint. Nothing in
this repo can verify an endpoint from a JSON file - preflight() and --selftest do
that live, on the first call, and that is the only place the claim is checked.

SESSION TRANSPORT (ADR-0005): each provider may declare a harness - a CLI whose own login powers model calls. Resolution is session-FIRST: if the harness command resolves on this machine, deepresearch spawns it per call and never opens a socket; API-key HTTP is the fallback for headless machines with no logins. DR_TRANSPORT=http forces the old path. The owner's deployment reality is the spec: 'we don't use API keys - we use oauth or -p to power them.'

claude.label: Anthropic
claude.systemPrefix: You are Claude Code, Anthropic's official CLI for Claude.

harness.label: claude -p
harness.note: Claude Code headless print mode. Powered by the machine's Claude Code login (~/.claude/.credentials.json OAuth) - deepresearch never reads the credential and no API key exists in the path.

glm.label: Z.ai GLM
glm.systemPrefix: You are GLM, a large language model trained by Z.ai, running as the model inside a multi-agent research harness.

harness.label: hermes -p glm -z
harness.note: The hermes gateway's one-shot mode with the zai provider selected. Powered by hermes' own held credential for the GLM plan - deepresearch holds nothing. Where hermes is not on PATH, DR_GLM_HARNESS carries a full command string (e.g. 'docker exec <container> /opt/hermes/.venv/bin/hermes').

harnessStdio.label: zcode session (stdio)
harnessStdio.note: The third transport (ADR-0005): the engine speaks newline-delimited JSON on stdin/stdout - one request {id, prompt, schema} out, one reply {id, reply} in - and the driving session window IS the model, on its own subscription. Selected with DR_TRANSPORT=stdio; no credential exists anywhere in the path, and calls are serialized behind a lock because one window is one rater.
